issues.criteria_ref: timeline-three-rounds must-show 大图; attempt-selected-actions must-show 大图完整显示（不超过 60vh、不被裁切）; design D-74 (width ≤ timeline column, height ≤ 60vh)
issues.observation: In the 900×700 viewport the expanded card's large image is only ~96–147px tall. In busy-other-media-narrow and running-other-session-narrow it is exactly thumbnail size (~96px), directly under the 96px thumbnail. The expanded card spends height on a header thumbnail, the full prompt, a second copy of the prompt, 高级参数 and the actions, and the image is shrunk to fit whatever remains in the visible timeline, although D-74 allows ~500×420 here. Wide captures get 182–247px. Nothing is clipped, but the page's core output cannot really be viewed.
issues.repair_suggestion: Hide the header thumbnail and the duplicate prompt when a card is expanded (frees ~130px). Give the large image a real floor, e.g. max-height: min(60vh, timeline height − ~150px) with min-height ~240–280px, and let the actions scroll into view rather than shrinking the image. Then re-capture the narrow screenshots.

issues.criteria_ref: Global rules (ellipsis allowed on session titles); batch visual question 6 (readable)
issues.observation: When the 生成中 badge is shown, the session title is cut to 3–4 characters (会失败的…, 甲会话：…, 甲会话的…, 删除时还…) although ~90px to the right of the badge is empty. The space looks reserved for the edit/delete buttons, which are not rendered. The generating session cannot be identified by name.
issues.repair_suggestion: Reserve action-button width only when the buttons are rendered (or on hover/current), or move the 生成中 badge to the meta line so the title gets the full row.

issues.criteria_ref: Design D-73/D-74 (collapsed header shows a ≤2-line summary; the expanded body adds the full prompt)
issues.observation: Expanded cards show the full prompt in the header and again under the image, and the 96px thumbnail duplicates the large image. This redundancy is the cause of R1-001.
issues.repair_suggestion: When expanded, hide the header thumbnail and header prompt, or reduce the header prompt to a one-line summary.

issues.observation: The bottom edge of the 新会话 button (y≈146) touches the first session card's top border (y≈147) with no gap. This happens in every image-page screenshot and looks cramped, almost overlapping the highlighted item's border.
issues.repair_suggestion: Add ~8–12px margin below the 新会话 button.

issues.observation: The empty state still says 点「生成图片」 while the button is disabled; the status line does give the reason.
issues.repair_suggestion: Optionally point the empty state at the unavailable reason.

issues.criteria_ref: library-after-delete must-show 图片页会话列表里已无该会话
issues.observation: The capture is scrolled to the bottom of the library: the app header and tabs are off-screen, and in the narrow capture the target row is cut at the viewport edge. The image-page half of the must-show appears only in verify-after-delete-*. The real preview image and the 正在预览 label are visible.
issues.repair_suggestion: Frame the header and target row, or pair the capture explicitly with verify-after-delete.

issues.observation: The timeline is scrolled, so the top card's header is cut by the scroll-container edge. This is normal scroll clipping, not a defect.

summary: All 54 screenshots were opened and inspected. Layout, clipping, blank states, seed word, per-state copy and disabled states pass at both widths; no blockers. One major: in the narrow viewport the expanded 大图 is thumbnail-sized (96–147px; exactly thumbnail size in busy-other-media-narrow and running-other-session-narrow). The expanded card duplicates the thumbnail and the prompt, and the image is shrunk to make the card fit. 3 minors: session titles cut too short beside the 生成中 badge, redundant prompt/thumbnail in expanded cards, and the 新会话 button touching the first card. 6 notes.
